specification:
GEOMETRY ROOT — [ACTOR_1] is positioned immediately behind [ACTOR_2] in a close rear-aligned standing hinge. [ACTOR_2] bends forward through the hip joints with mild anterior pelvic tilt, a gentle inward lumbar line, and softly flexed knees; avoid a rounded upper/lower-back silhouette. Both actors retain their assigned body and furniture support contacts.

BASE SUPPORT GEOMETRY — USER-SUPPLIED DESIGN CONSTRAINTS, not image-observed: [ACTOR_2] makes a deeper hip hinge toward a low horizontal support near knee height, with both hands or forearms bearing forward support. Knees bend softly but both people remain standing. The chest is substantially lower than the hips. Keep a subtle inward lower-back contour, without forcing a hyperextended spine. [ACTOR_1] remains standing behind, flexing the knees enough to follow the front hip height. FRONT SUPPORT: Both feet on [FLOOR]; both palms or forearms on stable [LOW_HORIZONTAL_SURFACE] near knee height; do not kneel. REAR SUPPORT: Both feet of [ACTOR_1] supported by [FLOOR]; knees softly flexed.

STRUCTURAL VARIATION — Baseline support geometry remains unchanged.

V00 REAR ARM DEFAULT — Both rear forearms travel forward outside the front upper arms; the palms settle near the outer shoulders/upper arms and turn inward, keeping the two upper torsos closely aligned. Baseline rear-arm placement; no additional variation angle.

CONTACT ARRANGEMENT — Two rear arms may be used for shoulder, underarm or chest-level routes; at forehead, mouth-line or neck-side destinations, one rear hand takes the upper destination and the other makes a single opposite-side hip cup.

INHERITANCE AND SUPPORT — Preserve the exact named leg/surface support topology and independent balance anchors from the base. Parent: USDG-LOW-V00. No paired inheritance change.

SOURCE BOUNDARY — User-designed text geometry, no source photograph or demonstrated physical pose; geometry and model fidelity remain untested.
